The Cabinet makes the following Regulations under Section 66 of the Trademarks
Act 2019:
1 Citation
These Regulations may be cited as the Trademarks (Forms and Fees)
Regulations 2020.
2 Commencement
These Regulations commence on the day they are notified in the Gazette.
3 Objectives
The objectives of these Regulations are to:
(a) provide the forms required for the necessary applications under the Act;
(b) providethefeesrequiredforthenecessaryapplicationsundertheAct;and
(c) provide the form of the Register of Trademarks.
4 Register of Trademarks
ForthepurposesofSection7oftheAct,theRegisterestablishedandmaintained
by the Registrar may be kept as set out in Schedule 1:
(a) in writing; and
(b) in digital or electronic form.
5 Application for registration of trademark
(1) For the purposes of Section 9 of theAct, an application for registration of
atrademarkshallbemadeforoneclassofgoodsorserviceswhichshallbe
in Form 1 of Schedule 2.
[subreg(1)insrtSL24of2022reg4,opn25Aug2022]
(2) For the purpose of Section 9(1)(f) of the Act, the goods and services
submitted for trademark registration shall be classified using the Nice
Classification established by the NiceAgreement (1957).
[subreg(2)insrtSL24of2022reg4,opn25Aug2022]
(3) For the purpose of subregulation (2), ‘Nice Agreement (1957)’ means the
Nice Agreement concerning the International Classification of Goods and
Services for the purposes of the Registration of Marks (1957).
[subreg(3)insrtSL24of2022reg4,opn25Aug2022]
(4) For the purposes of Section 35 of the Act, the prescribed annual fee for
maintaining a trademark is set out in Schedule 3.
[subreg(4)insrtSL24of2022reg4,opn25Aug2022]
6 Notification of application in the Gazette
ForthepurposesofSection10oftheAct,anotificationofanapplicationinthe
Gazette shall be in Form 2 of Schedule 2.
7 Opposition to application
ForthepurposesofSection11oftheAct,anoticeofoppositionshallbeinForm
3 of Schedule 2.

(1) For the purposes of Section 15 of the Act, a notice for non-complying
application shall be in Form 4 of Schedule 2.
(2) The applicant shall provide a response or amend the application within 30
days of receipt of such notice.
9 Amendment of pending application for registration
For the purposes of Section 16(1) of the Act, an application form for the
amendment of a pending application for the registration of a mark shall be in
Form 5 of Schedule 2.
10 Notice of decision
ForthepurposesofSection17oftheAct,anoticeofdecisionbytheRegistrar
shall be in Form 6 of Schedule 2.
11 Certificate of registration
For the purposes of Section 18(a) of the Act, a certificate of registration of a
trademark shall be in Form 7 of Schedule 2.
12 Publication of trademark in Gazette
For the purposes of Section 18(b) of theAct, a publication in the Gazette shall
be in Form 8 of Schedule 2.
13 Application for renewal
For the purposes of Section 36 of theAct, an application form for the renewal
of a registered trademark shall be in Form 9 of Schedule 2.
14 Application for correction of Register
ForthepurposesofSection37oftheAct,anapplicationformforcorrectionof
the Register shall be in Form 10 of Schedule 2.
15 Surrender of trademark
ForthepurposesofSection38oftheAct,anapplicationformforthesurrender
of a trademark shall be in Form 11 of Schedule 2.
16 Alteration of trademark
ForthepurposesofSection39oftheAct,anapplicationformforthealteration
of a trademark shall be in Form 12 of Schedule 2.
17 Addition of goods or services
For the purposes of Section 40 of theAct, an application form for the addition
of goods or services shall be in Form 13 of Schedule 2.
18 Application for removal for non-use of trademark
For the purposes of Section 41(1) of the Act, an application form for the
removal of a trademark from the Register shall be in Form 14 of Schedule 2.
